presets.name: Nothing acts after reading outside content
presets.cost: Once a run has read a web page, an email or a connected app, it can't send, run commands or change anything in your apps for the rest of that run — even when what it read was harmless. Start a new turn to act on it.

presets.name: Never send messages
presets.cost: Assistants can still write the message. You send it yourself.

presets.name: Don't touch secret files
presets.when: (intent in ["read_file", "write_file", "list_files"] && (file.name == ".env" || startsWith(file.name, ".env.") || file.extension in ["pem", "key", "p12", "pfx", "kdbx"] || contains(file.path, ".ssh/") || contains(file.path, ".aws/") || contains(file.path, ".gnupg/"))) || (intent == "run_command" && (contains(command, ".env") || contains(command, ".ssh/") || contains(command, ".aws/")))
presets.cost: Goes by names and folders, so a key saved as notes.txt is not covered, and a script can still read what a command line doesn't mention.

presets.name: No commands that delete
presets.cost: A filter on the words of a command, not a wall: a script or a program can still delete. It stops the obvious cases, including ones you would have approved.

presets.name: Connected apps are read-only
presets.cost: Assistants can search your issues, pages and messages, but can't file, edit, post or delete anything in those apps.

presets.name: Scheduled and background runs only look
presets.cost: Automations can look things up and report back into their conversation, but can't save files, run commands or send anything — including the report files some automations write.

presets.name: Never submit a form in the browser
presets.when: (intent == "activate" && (contains(element.name, "submit") || contains(element.name, "send") || contains(element.name, "place order") || contains(element.name, "pay") || contains(element.name, "confirm"))) || (tool.name in ["browser_key", "browser_type"] && key == "Enter")
presets.cost: Also stops pressing Enter anywhere in the assistant's browser, including in a search box. Buttons are matched by their label, so one that submits while saying "Continue" is not covered.

presets.name: Stay off social media
presets.when: intent == "navigate" && (page.host in ["facebook.com", "x.com", "twitter.com", "instagram.com", "tiktok.com", "reddit.com", "linkedin.com"] || endsWith(page.host, ".facebook.com") || endsWith(page.host, ".x.com") || endsWith(page.host, ".twitter.com") || endsWith(page.host, ".instagram.com") || endsWith(page.host, ".tiktok.com") || endsWith(page.host, ".reddit.com") || endsWith(page.host, ".linkedin.com"))
presets.cost: Names these sites only. A link shortener or another site that shows their pages is not covered.

read, write_local, exec or external

A file's path, as the assistant gave it
Just the file's name, e.g. .env
Lower-case, without the dot — empty for dotfiles like .env
An address being fetched or opened, without its query
Just the host, e.g. example.com
What the action touches, in words: a channel, a host, a connected app
The connected app a tool belongs to
That app's own name for the tool
read or write — empty for anything that is not a connected app's tool
Which assistant is acting
What started the run: person, approval, schedule, watch, message, subagent or api
The schedule, watch or channel that started it
true when nobody is watching the run happen
true once the run has read something from outside this machine — a web page, an email, a connected app
How many characters of text the action carries, e.g. a message's length
The conversation the run belongs to
A key about to be pressed in an assistant's own browser — Enter when typing ends in a submit
The label of what is being clicked or typed into, as the browser's own snapshot names it
button, link, textbox, checkbox, …
The element's reference in the page snapshot
An input's type, e.g. password or email
The same as persona.id
